name: Body
description: Marks the start of the edicts. Everything after it is edict groups (R15).

name: Flags
description: Bitfield: bit 0 Etching, bit 1 Terms, bit 2 Turbo, bit 127 reserved (R18).

name: Rune
description: The etched rune's name as a base-26 integer (R21). Requires the Etching flag.

name: Premine
description: Atomic units allocated to the etching transaction itself. u128. Requires the Etching flag.

name: Cap
description: Maximum number of mints. u128. Requires the Etching and Terms flags.

name: Amount
description: Atomic units created per mint. u128. Requires the Etching and Terms flags.

name: HeightStart
description: Absolute first block in which minting is allowed. Must fit u64. Requires Etching and Terms.

name: HeightEnd
description: Absolute block at and after which minting is disallowed. Must fit u64. Requires Etching and Terms.

name: OffsetStart
description: Mint opens this many blocks after the etching block. Must fit u64. Requires Etching and Terms.

name: OffsetEnd
description: Mint closes this many blocks after the etching block. Must fit u64. Requires Etching and Terms.

name: Mint
description: The rune ID to mint, given as two values: block, then transaction index (R31).

name: Pointer
description: Output index that receives unallocated runes. Must fit u32 and be less than the output count (R39).

name: Cenotaph
description: Reserved. Unrecognized by definition; its presence makes the transaction a cenotaph (R17).

name: Divisibility
description: Decimal places, 0 to 38. Out-of-range values are ignored. Requires the Etching flag.

name: Spacers
description: Bitmap of spacer dots between name letters, at most 0x07FFFFFF. Out-of-range ignored. Requires Etching.

name: Symbol
description: Currency symbol as a Unicode scalar value. Invalid values are ignored. Requires Etching.
